title: Blokoparkur
desc: Blokoparkur is a first-person parkour game in a world made of blocks. Run, jump from block to block and reach the portal at the end of each level to unlock the next one. 20 levels take you from a sunny meadow and a forest stream to ice islands, fire ruins, a volcano forge and a crystal dawn. Every world has its own obstacles: moving platforms and lifts, crumbling blocks, slippery ice and slime that bounces you high into the air. Each level hides three diamonds - collect all 60. Checkpoints keep you from starting over, and the timer shows where you can be faster. Your best time on every level is saved, and the sum of your best times on the first 11 levels goes to the records table. Play on desktop or mobile: touch screens get a joystick and a jump button. The game is in English and Russian: the language follows the browser.

title: Save the Pets
desc: Save the Pets is a funny drawing puzzle game. Angry bees are about to pour out of the hive, and a nervous shiba needs your help! Your ink is limited, so think before you draw. LEVELS: 72 handmade levels. Each one adds new twists: water, spikes, bombs, ice, rocks, spiders, fans and balloons. Choose any unlocked level from the level map and replay to improve your score. STARS & REWARDS: use less ink to earn up to 3 stars, collect coins and unlock new dog skins in the shop. HELPERS: stuck?
